---
name: Item error report
about: Report an item that seems keyed wrongly, has a flawed option or a weak explanation
title: "Item error: exam X, item NN"
labels: item error
assignees: surenderdhonapati
---

**Exam**
A, B, C or D.

**Item number as shown in the review**
The number in the review list on the results page (for example 37).

**What seems wrong**
The key, an option, the explanation, or the stem. Say what you think the correct answer is and why.

**Reference**
A source that supports your view, if you have one (outline bullet, standard, official guide, page or section).

**Accessibility barrier**
If you are reporting a barrier instead of an item error, describe what you tried, the browser and any assistive technology you use, and what happened.
